title: Shopper Support Academy — Payout Card Plans and the Cartwise Shopper Batches Long-Distance Uplift
content:
The long-distance card uplift on Cartwise Shopper Batches follows the plan of the shopper's payout account in Cartwise Shopper Payouts:

- **1.10** when the payout account is on an Everyday Pay Card plan at the Gold tier or above (Everyday Pay Card Gold, Platinum or Diamond — the plans paying fuel cashback of 3 percent or more);
- **1.05** when it is on the Everyday Pay Card Blue plan (fuel cashback above zero and below 3 percent);
- **1.00** for every other payout plan, or when no payout account exists.

The uplift multiplies the whole long-distance bonus as it stands before rounding, and only then is the bonus rounded once to the cent half up.

## Training questions

**Which record decides the uplift?** The plan the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Payouts account is on, as the payout account record shows it.

**What does a Weekly Direct Deposit or Instant Cashout plan receive?** 1.00 — neither is an Everyday Pay Card plan paying fuel cashback.

**What if the shopper has no payout account?** 1.00.

**Is the uplift applied before or after rounding?** Before: the unrounded bonus is multiplied, and the single rounding to the cent half up comes last.

## Worked figures (hypothetical bonus)

| Payout plan | Unrounded bonus | Uplift | Bonus posted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Everyday Pay Card Platinum | 3.40 | 1.10 | 3.74 |
| Everyday Pay Card Blue | 3.40 | 1.05 | 3.57 |
| Weekly Direct Deposit | 3.40 | 1.00 | 3.40 |
| Everyday Pay Card Gold | 2.95 | 1.10 | 3.245, rounded half up to 3.25 |
